clips.title: The story
paras: Newly risen Forsaken face the Mindless Ones on Deathknell's northern edge. Shadow Priest Sarvis sends them to cull Mindless Zombies and Wretched Zombies, Scourge thralls bound to the Lich King's command.

Many who rise from Lordaeron's dirt never recover their minds. The Forsaken broke free of Ner'zhul's domination as his power waned, but countless corpses remain chained to his will. In northern Deathknell, Mindless Zombies and Wretched Zombies wander, driven to violence. For you, newly risen among the undead, putting them down is the first hard trial. You prove your freedom by ending the thrall of those who never escaped.

Shadow Priest Sarvis grieves that these legions of dead cannot strengthen the Forsaken's desperate struggle. There is no cure for them. Their minds are broken, and they remain instruments of slaughter. If left to roam, they bring chaos to Deathknell's doorstep and give the Lich King easy fodder. Destroying them is necessary for the settlement and brings a grim end to some of Lordaeron's fallen.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We Forsaken are at war with the Lich King's army of the Scourge: necromantically raised armies of the traveler, foul beasts of the north, and tormented spectres.

The northern part of the village has become overrun with the Mindless Ones, and they must be destroyed. Destroy them, show them no mercy, our former brothers and sisters as they might be. The Fallen are nothing but The Lich King's slaves.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You will not go far in this new life if you are unable to kill even the weakest of zombies, friend. Do not return until you have success to report.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is unfortunate that the Scourge cannot be brought into the fold, their large numbers would be useful in the battles ahead.
But they will not join us, so we have no choice but to destroy them.
